subject: Re: CloudForge pilot - credit memo & invoice offset coordination
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@cloudforge.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot wrap / request for credit memo and invoice offset

Hi Diego —

Quick note from CloudForge as we wind down the 6-week pilot. We landed about 230k tokens of usage over the pilot window and want to request: (1) a formal credit memo to cover the pilot allowance we agreed to, (2) instructions for how you want us to apply that credit against the final invoice (offset vs. separate credit memo), and (3) any GL/accounting fields you need on your side so our AP team can accept the credit cleanly.

I’ve copied our AP address (accounts@cloudforge.com). We can accept a PDF credit memo and a short note describing the offset if that’s easier. Do you need anything else from us to start?

Thanks —
Lena Ortiz
Director, Cloud Partnerships
CloudForge

Attachment: usage-summary-cloudforge-20261107.csv (stub)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@cloudforge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T11:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap / request for credit memo and invoice offset

Hi Lena —

Thanks for the summary and the usage file. We can do a credit memo that the AP team can apply as an invoice offset. To make sure this posts cleanly on both sides, two quick asks:

1) Can you confirm the billing contact name and PO or invoice number you want the credit to reference?
2) We need your preferred offset approach: apply credit to the next net invoice (preferred) or issue a standalone credit memo for your records.
3) Any specific GL code you need us to populate on the credit note? If CloudForge has a specific clearing acct, list it and we’ll mirror it in the memo.

I’ve looped Monica from Finance to draft the memo and confirm the ledger mapping. Marissa is on the account team — she’ll own the final handoff and confirm timing with your AP.

I’ll aim to share a draft credit memo and the recommended offset language by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Diego
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
Original attachment referenced: usage-summary-cloudforge-20261107.csv (stub)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena@cloudforge.com>, accounts@cloudforge.com
Date: 2026-11-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap / request for credit memo and invoice offset

Diego / Lena —

Finance here. Attached is a draft credit memo (CF-credit-memo-draft-20261108.pdf) and a simple GLA mapping sheet (redwood-gla-mapping_2026-11.xlsx). Notes:

- Credit value: $3,450 (pilot allowance agreed in SOW).
- Reference: please confirm Invoice # or PO to reference on the memo. If you don’t have an invoice number yet, we’ll reference the pilot SOW RDW-2026-0892.
- Preferred posting: invoice offset (apply to next Redwood invoice) — this keeps accounts receivable clean and avoids separate cash adjustments. If CloudForge requires a standalone reversal entry, we can provide a separate memo for your AP to post.
- GLA guidance: for Redwood posting, use GLA 4002 (Contra Revenue - Promotions). If CloudForge needs a specific clearing account, provide the code and we’ll include it on the memo.
- Tax: credit memos are non-taxable per our billing agreement for pilot allowances; we’ll include a line that states this for your AP.

Please review the attached draft and tell us whether to: A) issue and apply to next invoice, or B) issue standalone memo now for your records. If you choose A, confirm the invoice number to tie it to or approve referencing the SOW.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Manager, Billing Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachments: CF-credit-memo-draft-20261108.pdf (stub), redwood-gla-mapping_2026-11.xlsx (stub)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena@cloudforge.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, accounts@cloudforge.com
Date: 2026-11-11T16:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap / request for credit memo and invoice offset

Monica / Diego —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear options. CloudForge will take option A (apply to next invoice). Our AP confirms they can accept a memo referencing the SOW RDW-2026-0892 — no PO or invoice number available yet.

Please proceed to issue the credit memo with reference to the SOW and include the GLA line you recommended. Once the memo is issued, could you also send a one-line email to accounts@cloudforge.com confirming the offset amount and the next invoice number it will be applied to (so we can tie it to our AP record)?

Appreciate it —
Lena
